author: Codex
authorization_literal: continua con el plan de trabajo validando todo de forma exahustiva,, no pares en la validación y programa progresos para toda la noche, valida y vuelve a validar cada decisión que se tome, de preferencia empecemos por modelos estandar y en la medida que sea estrictamente necesario los vamos complejizando

objective.calibration: None beyond B12 fitted group constants and the B13 unpenalized GLM intercept/main effects; no post-fit scalar or mixture.
objective.primary_development_metric: Pooled unweighted total-unit D2 Tweedie 1.5 on all 50094 OOF rows of 2023; global null is arithmetic mean of observed T0; do not average line D2 scores
objective.positivity: Fail on nonfinite or nonpositive rate/prediction; no silent clipping or removal

observation_link: Each development fold k uses frozen exclude_foldk/e_cost_mix_1.0, fitted only on other 2023 groups; all three model families use exactly the same link and T0 response.
features: B12 uses only admissible x_new_business. B13 uses exact core whitelist. Existing masked capital stays masked; no climate, transferred factor or participant decision tables integrated in this controlled comparison.

models.formula: r_b=sum_fit_b(T0/sqrt(e))/sum_fit_b(sqrt(e)), b=x_new_business in {0,1}; no cap, smoothing, OOF calibration or post-fit anchor.

models.categorical: OneHotEncoder drop=first, min_frequency=50, max_categories=40, handle_unknown=ignore, fit-only

development_uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, conditional exploratory diagnostic; NOT the 2024 Bonferroni confirmation interval
development_uncertainty.pairs: All 91 pairs of fourteen recipes, shared 2000 exploratory component draws, no search/multiplicity correction.

diagnostics.observation_sensitivity: At fixed fitted OOF rates, recompute predictions and response for reserve075, reserve125, late_cost05, late_cost10 using saved scoped links. This is an observation-only diagnostic, not a refit or the complete confirmation safeguards.
diagnostics.no_selection: Keep B00 and every alternative; no promotion, retirement, equivalence or final confirmation roster here.

readout_before_testing.standard_models: Compare B12 vs B00 and B13 vs B12, reporting point, exploratory CI, own top31 influence, level and business x line. No promotion regardless.
readout_before_testing.complexity: No more complex recipe in this batch. A later step requires a documented residual issue not explained by contract/offset/available main effects.
readout_before_testing.capital_and_weather: Do not silently integrate new CLA003 tables. Preserve admissibility/temporal concerns for a separate audited recipe.

technical_acceptance: Only saved 2023 rows and five group folds
Exact T0/C0/previous OOF and source hashes
30 positive B12 constants from outer-training rows
15 GLM fits, core six-feature subset exact, transforms fit-only
GLM convergence plus independent penalization-free score gradient
Strictly positive finite predictions, same validation keys/target/link
Blocked-fit serialized replay and separate formulas/negative cases
All earlier alternatives and B00 retained, no 2024 or test consumer
scope: Night unit 1, only 2023, exact old F0 as source with prespecified subset. No temporal opening, prediction of test, transfer, weather, cap or blend.
resources: Local CPU two threads. Fifteen native GLM fits and thirty closed-form constants; no grid or seed change.
search_disclosure: Fifth adaptive development batch, two standard recipes fixed before fitting. Existing outcomes motivated business level analysis; intervals remain exploratory after 14 recipes and 91 pairs.
hypothesis: A business-segment constant and a small unpenalized main-effect GLM can clarify whether business level requires elaborate correction. Six prespecified technical features per line; no variable selection based on new scores.
